name: Security+ Domain 5 Trainer
description: An interactive, high-stakes trainer and exam simulator for CompTIA Security+ SY0-701 covering Domain 1 (General Security Concepts), Domain 2 (Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Mitigations), Domain 3 (Security Architecture), Domain 4 (Security Operations) and Domain 5 (Security Program Management and Oversight) featuring study modules, custom quizzes, and an AI Cybersecurity Trainer assistant.
